mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'ORDERED'

SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'ORDERED' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, p.product_id ASC
